scripts.build:android: npm run mkdist && react-native bundle --entry-file index.js --platform android --dev true --bundle-output dist/main.android.jsbundle --assets-dest dist/res && react-native build-android --extra-params "--no-daemon --console=plain -PreactNativeArchitectures=arm64-v8a"
scripts.build:android:apk: npm run mkdist && react-native bundle --entry-file index.js --platform android --dev false --bundle-output dist/main.android.jsbundle --assets-dest dist/res && react-native build-android --tasks assembleRelease --extra-params "--no-daemon --console=plain -PreactNativeArchitectures=arm64-v8a" && echo "APK gotowe: android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk"
scripts.build:ios: npm run mkdist && react-native bundle --entry-file index.js --platform ios --dev true --bundle-output dist/main.ios.jsbundle --assets-dest dist && react-native build-ios --mode Debug
scripts.setup:ios: ruby ios/link_bunny_sdk.rb --prepare && pod install --project-directory=ios && ruby ios/link_bunny_sdk.rb
scripts.build:ios:archive: npm run mkdist && react-native bundle --entry-file index.js --platform ios --dev false --bundle-output dist/main.ios.jsbundle --assets-dest dist && npm run setup:ios && xcodebuild archive -workspace ios/BunnyStreamReactNativeExample.xcworkspace -scheme BunnyStreamExample -configuration Release -archivePath ios/build/BunnyStreamExample-AppStore.xcarchive -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -skipPackagePluginValidation -allowProvisioningUpdates && echo "Archive gotowe: ios/build/BunnyStreamExample-AppStore.xcarchive"
scripts.build:ios:ipa: npm run build:ios:archive && xcodebuild -exportArchive -archivePath ios/build/BunnyStreamExample-AppStore.xcarchive -exportOptionsPlist ios/ExportOptions.plist -exportPath ios/build/ipa -allowProvisioningUpdates && echo "IPA gotowe: ios/build/ipa/"
scripts.ios: pod install --project-directory=ios && ruby ios/link_bunny_sdk.rb && react-native run-ios --scheme BunnyStreamExample --extra-params "-skipPackagePluginValidation"
